scope: CVG-004 bounded durable Vetus import idempotency and reconciliation integrity

criteria.description: The import-integrity scope, authority, exclusions and non-promotion boundary are recorded.
criteria.limitations: Only the repository-local import control plane and disposable verification are authorized; external Vetus reconciliation and target behavior remain open.

criteria.description: The existing durable import logs/batches, unique tenant source-reference indexes, RLS policies, tenant UoW and owner/patient persistence boundaries are present for an additive hardening.
criteria.limitations: The current source-reference replay path does not yet compare durable payload fingerprints or serialize acquisition.

criteria.description: Focused RED tests can prove divergent replay rejection, durable single/batch persistence, dry-run/rejected/resume/rollback behavior and two-tenant HTTP isolation before implementation.
criteria.limitations: A bounded result requires the new migration, implementation, fresh PostgreSQL HTTP evidence, security review and control-plane reconciliation.

gaps: The additive fingerprint migration, source-reference lock, divergent replay conflict and database-backed HTTP evidence are not complete at gate creation.

authority.scope: CVG-004 bounded durable Vetus import idempotency and reconciliation integrity
authority.decision: Authorize reversible repository implementation, one additive canonical migration and disposable PostgreSQL/authenticated HTTP verification for internal source-payload fingerprints, divergent source-reference conflicts and transaction-safe acquisition. Exclude external Vetus/Live Pet/Live Lab, providers, credentials, target, production, deployment, backfill and release acceptance.
authority.expires_or_revalidates: Revalidate before external import reconciliation, backfill, provider/target operation, credential handling, production/deployment or release action.

next_action: Write the route RED tests for divergent single/batch replay, then implement the bounded durable fingerprint/lock path before running fresh PostgreSQL HTTP verification.
revalidation_triggers: Changes to Vetus import identity, owner/patient persistence composition or rollback semantics
Changes to migrations 0098/0102 or the additive fingerprint migration
Any external Vetus/Live Pet/Live Lab integration, provider, target, credential, production, deployment or release expansion
